description: Minister of Transport Highways Ports and Civil Aviation - Merchant Shipping Act. No 52 of 1971 Merchant Shipping (Chategerisation of waters Regulations No,02 of 2024)
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Merchant Shipping Act, No. 52 of 1971, which establishes new legal/regulatory frameworks for categorizing waters where registered vessels in Sri Lanka shall operate. It defines various water categories, operational areas, and technical terms, making it a statutory instrument that falls under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel or structural changes.
